name: Fog of Love
summary: A two-player romantic comedy simulator where partners play out a relationship from meeting to destiny.
rules_text: Two players each create a character: choose an occupation and three personality traits, and receive three visible features chosen by the partner who narrates first impressions. Each player also secretly draws three destiny cards that require specific values or balances on six personality dimensions (e.g., Discipline vs Humor). A story deck is divided into chapters. On a turn the active player draws a scene card and reads a dilemma. Some scenes offer simultaneous choices, others one player decides and the other reacts. Each option moves your markers on the six traits and gives personal satisfaction and joint satisfaction tokens. Players are encouraged to justify choices in character. After each chapter, play proceeds to the next. At the finale each player reveals destinies: you gain bonus happiness if your final traits match them. Then tally individual happiness against thresholds and joint happiness to determine if each person is fulfilled and whether the couple stays together, breaks up amicably, or heartbroken.
rating_reason: Two-player narrative with hidden goals fits engine well
